inbox.title: Your calls, texts and chats in one place
inbox.what: Your agent's conversations show up here as they happen.
inbox.does: Handle cancellation, reschedule and callback requests on the conversation.
inbox.how: Filter by channel to see only calls, texts or chats.

appointments.title: Your bookings on one calendar
appointments.what: Each booking your agent makes shows up here.
appointments.does: Click an empty time to book an appointment yourself.
appointments.how: Add time off to block hours your agent can't book.

agents.title: Set up how each agent answers
agents.what: Each agent has its own number, greeting, voice, rules, booking and transfers.
agents.shared: All your agents share your business details, services and knowledge.
agents.does: The default agent answers anything you haven't given to another agent.
agents.how: Make a change, then click Test Call to hear it.

rules.title: Tell your agent what to do and when
rules.what: A rule tells your agent what to do when something happens.
rules.does: For example, when a caller mentions an emergency, transfer them to you.
rules.how: Limit a rule to one channel, such as phone calls.

channels.title: Where customers reach this agent
channels.what: A channel is a phone number, the website widget or Instagram.
channels.does: This agent answers on every channel you connect here.
channels.how: Move a channel to another agent to change who answers it.

knowledge.title: What your agent knows about your business
knowledge.what: Your agent answers from your website, files and FAQs.
knowledge.does: Check unanswered questions to see what to add.
knowledge.how: Add a web page, a file or an FAQ to fill a gap.

services.title: The services your agent books
services.what: List what you offer, with a duration and a price for each.
services.does: Your agent quotes these prices and books these durations.
services.how: Add a service, or edit one to change its price or length.

employees.title: The people callers can book
employees.what: List who works here and the services each person does.
employees.does: Callers can ask for someone by name to book with them.
employees.how: Add a phone number so your agent can transfer calls to that person.

analytics.title: See how many calls and bookings your agent handles
analytics.what: The top row shows calls, today's appointments and the average call length.
analytics.does: The chart tracks calls and messages over time, split by agent when you have several.
analytics.how: Pick a date range and an interval to compare two periods.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.first: Wants to move Friday's visit to Monday.
inbox.second: Asked for a call back after 5 PM.

rules.title: Rules
rules.emergencyAction: Transfer the call to the owner
rules.afterHours: A chat comes in after hours
rules.afterHoursAction: Take a message for the team
